_note: Core/Device (parity/F06-device.md), the LOCALE derivations. Runtime localization is a gap this closes: an app could not previously ask what region, calendar or measurement system the user actually has. What is pinned here is the part that is a FOLD rather than a platform read: region separated from language, the measurement system, the temperature unit that follows it, and text direction. `locales` ordering is pinned as a rule (the platform's own preference order, not sorted, not deduplicated to one) because a language picker needs the list, and the top entry alone is the thing every framework gets wrong.
_runner: No runner is wired yet (registration is in the F06 handoff).

measurementSystem.name: the United Kingdom is its own hybrid, and is not metric
an unknown region is metric, because most of the world is

direction.name: direction follows the LANGUAGE, not the region: Arabic in France is still RTL
a bare language tag still resolves

region.name: language and region are separate fields, not one string
a script subtag does not become the region
a bare language has no region

locales.name: the preference ORDER is preserved, because that is what a language picker needs
one preferred language is a one-element list, never a bare string
